title: norn flow
description: A norn flow: the process for the issues of one type, in .agents/flows/<name>.json. The file name is the flow's name and its type: an issue labelled type:<name> runs it. The schema checks the shape; norn doctor also checks what it cannot, e.g. that every target is a state and every state can reach an end.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema.

description.description: What the flow is for. Triage offers the flow with it.

start.description: The state an issue enters the flow in.

workspace.description: Where the work happens: none, no branch; own, a branch and a PR into the base branch; parent, a branch and a PR into the parent issue's branch.

triage.description: Whether triage offers the flow as an outcome. Default true.

states.description: The states, by name. Each name is the label of the state on GitHub. closed, not-planned, in-progress and needs-human are norn's own.

renamed.description: Old state name to its new one: an issue still in the old state moves to the new one when norn next touches it.

skill.description: The skill the briefing names for the step.

attended.description: Whether a person takes part in the step.

name.description: The step's human name, e.g. agent QA. Default: the state's name.

enterAs.description: The state the issue moves to when the step is taken.

description.description: What the state means: its label's description and the dashboard's wording.

color.description: The label's colour, hex without the #, e.g. 1d76db.

evidence.description: The step can attach evidence files with norn done --evidence <dir>.

when.description: The only mode the state runs in. In the other mode norn follows passThrough instead of entering it.

passThrough.description: With when: the outcome word norn follows when the issue's mode skips the state.

outcomes.description: How the step can end, by outcome word. The empty word is the single way to end.

to.description: A state of the flow, closed or not-planned.

means.description: How the briefing describes the outcome.

meansSkipped.description: How it is described instead when the issue's mode skips the state it leads to.

note.description: The outcome needs a note; this names it, e.g. reason.

needsHuman.description: After the transition, set needs-human; this says who must do what.

notify.description: After the transition, a person does QA and is notified; a human gate does this on its own. It leads only into an attended state or a human gate, never an agent's.

behaviours.description: Built-in mechanics the state opts into, by name, with their parameters ({} for none).

writesSpec.description: The step writes the spec, pushed to the issue's branch. Needs workspace own.

readsIssue.description: The briefing has the agent read the issue first.

countsFixRounds.description: The state counts fix rounds; at the team's maxFixRounds the issue goes to needs-human.

opensPR.description: The step opens the issue's PR; later states see it. Needs workspace own or parent.

waitsForSlices.description: The issue waits until its slices are closed, then norn opens its PR and moves it on. Needs workspace own.

to.description: The state the issue moves to once its slices are done.

humanGate.description: A person checks the work here: norn notifies them, and the step can attach evidence.

mergesSlice.description: Leaving needs the PR merged into the parent's branch; then norn tidies up and releases blocked siblings. Needs workspace parent.

syncsBlocked.description: The issue waits while it has open blockers, then norn releases it.

to.description: The state the issue is released to.

slices.description: The step creates slices with norn add-slice; leaving needs at least one.

type.description: The flow the slices run, e.g. slice.

waitsForMerge.description: The issue's owner merges its PR; norn closes the issue once it is merged. Needs workspace own.
